project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Ruabon
townGuide.intro: Ruabon has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.
